const { waitForBridge } = await requireModuleByName("obsidianBridge.ts");
await waitForBridge(5000);  // Throws after 5s timeout

<NativeModalPortal
  onClose={handleClose}
  title="Settings"
  modalClass="dmt-settings-modal"
  draggable={true}
  resizable={true}
  contextBridge={(children) => (
    <SomeProvider value={value}>
      {children}
    </SomeProvider>
  )}
>
  <PreactContent />
</NativeModalPortal>
